name: @niq.run/agent-interface-worker
description: Agent interface worker for niq (CLI form) — dial a niq event bus from the shell, send directed events, request a capability reply, or stream bus events. Credentials come from a local multi-source file matching the WebUI's remote-worker connect block.

scripts.release: git diff --quiet && git diff --cached --quiet || { echo "Error: git working tree not clean" >&2; exit 1; } && npm run test && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm version --no-git-tag-version && npm publish
